persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Can you add English subtitles to this? Put them on the video and keep the original sound and framing.
bank.Source and length: Use the attached talk-one.mp4, all 10 seconds.
bank.Subtitle language and wording: English, faithfully transcribing the woman's speech.
bank.Subtitle delivery: Visible subtitles on the exported video, not just a transcript or subtitle file.
bank.Style and placement: Your call; keep them readable and away from her face.
bank.Size and framing: Keep the source framing; free-tier 480p is fine.
bank.Audio: Keep the original voice and sound; no added music or narration.

messages.text: Can you add English subtitles to the attached clip? I’m a little worried that subtitles might make it feel cluttered, but I’d really like to be able to follow what she’s saying. What I mean is, please use all 10 seconds of the clip and faithfully transcribe the woman’s speech in English. I want the subtitles visible on the exported video itself, rather than just getting a transcript or a separate subtitle file. The style and placement are your call, as long as they’re readable and stay away from her face. Please keep the original framing, and free-tier 480p is fine. Keep the original voice and sound too, without adding music or narration.
